title: Urgent Hiring - PBCS Functional Consultant
description:
Please find the job description for the role of Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant. 
 Job Title: Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud or Hyperion Planning Company: Mastek Limited Location: Ahmedabad/Mumbai/Noida/Chennai/Trichy/Hyderabad (Hybrid)Shift and Schedule: UK/US Shift 
 About Us Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
 Job Summary Mastek is seeking a proficient Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant to join the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) practice. The consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS) solutions for enterprise clients, primarily in the finance domain. The role involves working closely with finance stakeholders to understand budgeting, forecasting, and reporting requirements, translating them into scalable Oracle PBCS solutions, and ensuring smooth implementation and adoption. This position is ideal for a finance professional (CA or MBA Finance) with hands-on Oracle PBCS experience and a strong interest in technology-enabled performance management.
 Key Responsibilities 
Solution Design & Implementation Collaborate with business and finance stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document planning, budgeting, and forecasting requirements. Design end-to-end Oracle PBCS solutions, including data models, forms, business rules, calculations, and workflows. Configure PBCS applications (modules, dimensions, hierarchies, security, and metadata) in line with best practices. Develop and maintain input forms, dashboards, reports, and task lists to support planning and reporting processes. Participate in full project lifecycle activities: requirement analysis, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Functional & Process Expertise
 Map existing financial planning and budgeting processes to Oracle PBCS capabilities and recommend process improvements. Design and implement driver-based planning models, rolling forecasts, and scenario planning. Work with finance teams to align PBCS solutions with corporate budgeting, management reporting, and financial consolidation processes. Provide functional guidance on integration with upstream and downstream systems (ERP, data warehouses, reporting tools). Configuration, Testing & Documentation
 Configure business rules, calculations, allocations, and validations within PBCS. Support data integration and data management activities, including data loads, mappings, and validation. Develop and execute test scenarios and test scripts for unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Prepare functional design documents, configuration documents, user guides, and training materials. Stakeholder Management & Support
 Serve as a primary functional point of contact for clients on Oracle PBCS-related topics. Conduct user training sessions and workshops to drive solution adoption. Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting issues, and implementing enhancements. Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, and other consultants to ensure timely and quality delivery. Governance & Continuous Improvement
 Adhere to project governance, documentation standards, and change management processes. Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS updates, new features, and industry best practices. Recommend continuous improvements to existing PBCS implementations to enhance performance, usability, and value. Qualifications 
 3+ years of overall experience, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience as an Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud / Hyperion Planning functional consultant. Proven experience in: Designing and implementing Oracle PBCS planning applications. Building and managing dimensions, metadata, and data forms. Creating and maintaining business rules, calculations, and allocations. Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes. Proficient understanding of: Financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning. Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and key financial metrics. Experience in data integration and data management within PBCS (e.g., Data Management / Data Management integrations, flat file loads, ERP integrations). Skilled in working with stakeholders from finance and IT, translating business requirements into functional solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with other Oracle EPM Cloud modules (e.g., EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS) or on-premises Hyperion applications. Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS-related certifications. Experience with Oracle ERP (E-Business Suite, Oracle Cloud ERP) or other ERP systems. Exposure to scripting or automation in the EPM context (e.g., Groovy, calculation scripts, EPM Automate). Experience working in consulting environments or on multi-country / global implementations.

Key Skills: EPM,PBCS,Hyperion,Oracle EPM,Hyperion Planning,Enterprise Performance Management,Pvs,Hiring

title: Recruiting Solutions Professional
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we're on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 
 Job Description 
 Recruiting Solutions Project Manager, U.S. Bancorp India The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will support the U.S. Bancorp India Global Capability Center recruiting organization by enabling effective, compliant, and scalable recruiting operations across India. This position will play a central role in preparing and supporting recruiters through training, process and technology enhancements, change management, communications, risk and compliance coordination, and knowledge base management. The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will partner with the India recruiting team, Global Enterprise Recruiting Solutions team, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other key stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes and technology meet local business requirements, support a consistent recruiter and candidate experience, and are successfully adopted by the recruiting organization. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead and support recruiting operations, process, training, and technology initiatives for the U.S. Bancorp India GCC recruiting organization. Develop and deliver recruiter training, tools, job aids, and other enablement resources that strengthen recruiter readiness, process adherence, and operational consistency. Assess recruiter training needs and translate new or changing processes, policies, and technology capabilities into practical learning materials and communications. Partner with HR Product and Engineering teams to identify, document, prioritize, and track recruiting product enhancement requests based on India business and recruiter needs. Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing and post-implementation validation and hyper care for recruiting tools and system changes. Identify technology defects, process gaps, and user experience issues, document findings and partner with product team and vendors through resolution. Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other subject matter experts to ensure India recruiting processes, procedures, communications, and technology configurations align with applicable laws, regulatory expectations, company policies, and established controls. Develop and deliver appropriate change management, communication, training, and adoption plans in response to recruiting process, policy, and technology changes Monitor adoption of new recruiting processes and tools, gather feedback from users, identify barriers, and recommend actions to strengthen adoption and effectiveness. Maintain India recruiting knowledge base content and ensure materials remain accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with global standards and local requirements. Serve as a resource for India recruiters and recruiting leaders by addressing questions, identifying appropriate referrals, and supporting resolution of complex process and technology issues. Leverage recruiter feedback, operational data, testing results, and adoption insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Build strong partnerships across India recruiting, Global Enterprise Recruiting, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and successful delivery in a matrixed environment. Act as a recruiting operations and enablement subject matter expert by maintaining awareness of evolving business needs, India recruiting practices, technology capabilities, and industry trends. 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience. Five years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting, change management, HR technology, learning and development, or a related field. 
 Preferred Skills/Experience Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting operations, recruiter enablement, HR technology, process improvement, or large-scale organizational change. Experience developing and facilitating recruiter training, process education, job aids, presentations, and other enablement materials. Knowledge of recruiting processes and technology, preferably including Workday Recruiting, Phenom, or comparable applicant tracking and candidate relationship management platforms. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, enhancement requests, use cases, testing scenarios, and acceptance criteria. Experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect documentation, issue resolution, and implementation of HR or recruiting technology. Understanding of India recruitment practices, employment-related compliance requirements, and the importance of partnering with Legal and Risk to translate requirements into practical recruiting procedures. Experience developing communications and change management plans that support successful adoption of new processes, policies, and technology. Strong technical writing and process documentation skills, including the ability to create clear knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, process guides, and user-facing instructions. Ability to synthesize complex policy, legal, risk, process, and technology information into clear and actionable guidance for recruiters. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines. Innovative, resourceful, solutions-oriented, and committed to identifying opportunities to improve recruiting processes, workflows, user experience, and operational efficiency. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively across global and cross-functional teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively across India and U.S. time zones when collaboration with global stakeholders is required. Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of recruiting reporting, metrics, and analytics is preferred.

 This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

You will manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including role scoping, market research, sourcing, screening, and selection. Working closely with hiring partners, you will lead offer structuring, negotiation, and issuance, while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience throughout every stage. This is a dynamic opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of GE Vernova by building high-performing engineering teams. Job Description What Youll Do Serve as a strategic Talent Acquisition advisor/Talent Strategist for hiring team and manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned positions, including sourcing, screening, and selection of candidates. Collaborate with hiring partners to understand hiring needs and develop targeted, effective hiring strategies. Source and engage top engineering talent through advanced methods including headhunting, talent mapping, market research, networking, and social media - with a focus on passive and niche candidate profiles. Build and maintain diverse, inclusive talent pipelines that support GE Vernovas broader talent objectives. Deliver regular reporting and trend analysis to stakeholders, translating recruitment data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter hiring decisions. Champion an exceptional candidate experience at every touchpoint, from first contact through onboarding, representing GE Vernovas employer brand with clarity and conviction. Support employer branding and candidate engagement initiatives in partnership with the Talent Attraction team. Ensure recruitment processes comply with employment laws, regulations and internal policies. Serve as a strategic advisor to Hiring managers, providing market intelligence, candidacy trade-off analysis, and guidance on competitive offer structuring aligned with internal compensation frameworks and guidelines. Effectively communicate the value proposition of the organization, including career development, culture, and total rewards. Support onboarding activities by liaising with HR Ops Team and hiring managers to facilitate a smooth transition for new hires. Apply a solution-oriented mindset to address day-to-day recruitment challenges and propose effective solutions Required Qualifications/Skills Bachelors degree from an accredited university or college. MBA (HR) is a preference. 9+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition with a strong focus on engineering hiring across energy, power systems, industrial automation, or related technical domains Proven ability to manage the full recruitment cycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection. Demonstrated ability to lead complex, senior-level searches requiring advanced sourcing, offer negotiation, and executive stakeholder management Proven expertise in building and managing diverse talent pipelines through proactive headhunting, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement Proven ability to use recruitment data and market insights to optimize hiring outcomes and influence strategy Hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), particularly Workday Desired Skills: Experience working in both in-house corporate and agency recruiting environments Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally to all stakeholders. Strong interviewing skills, including behavioural and competency-based techniques, to accurately assess candidate fit for roles. Strong time management and organizational abilities to handle multiple roles and priorities efficiently. Strong willingness to embrace change and continuous learning Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Denials Specialist
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Accounts Receivable (“AR”) Specialists are primarily responsible for analyzing collections, resolving non\-payables, and handling bill inquiries for more complex issues. AR Specialists are responsible for insurance payer follow\-up ensuring claims are paid according to client contracts. Complies with all applicable laws regarding billing standards.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Follows up on claim rejections and denials to ensure appropriate reimbursement for our clients.
* Process assigned AR work lists provided by the manager in a timely manner.
* Write appeals using established guidelines to resolve claim denials with a goal of one contact resolution.
* Identified and resolved denied, non\-paid, and/or non\-adjudicated claims and billing issues due to coverage issues, medical record requests, and authorizations.
* Recommend accounts to be written off on Adjustment Request.
* Reports address and/or filing rule changes to the manager.
* Check the system for missing payments.
* Properly notates patient accounts.
* Review each piece of correspondence to determine specific problems.
* Research patient accounts.
* Reviews accounts and determines appropriate follow\-up actions (adjustments, letters, phone insurance, etc.).
* Processes and follows up on appeals. Files appeals on claim denials.
* Inbound/outbound calls may be required for follow\-up on accounts.
* Respond to insurance company claim inquiries.
* Communicates with insurance companies about the status of outstanding claims.
* Meet established production and quality standards as set by Ventra Health.
* Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1\) year in the data entry field and one (1\) year in medical billing and claims resolution preferred.
* AAHAM and/or HFMA certification preferred.
* Experience with offshore engagement and collaboration desired.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Intermediate level knowledge of medical billing rules, such as coordination of benefits, modifiers, Medicare, and Medicaid, and understanding of EOBs.
* Become proficient in the use of billing software within 4 weeks and maintain proficiency.
* Ability to read, understand and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic use of a computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .


**Ventra Health**

 Ventra Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culturally diverse organization. We strive for inclusiveness and a workplace where mutual respect is paramount. We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. We will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, as needed, to assist them in performing essential job functions.

**Solicitation of Payment**

**Attention Candidates**

These scammers may attempt to conduct fake interviews, solicit personal information, and, in some cases, have sent fraudulent offer letters.
   

  

 To protect yourself, verify any communication you receive by contacting us directly through our official channels. If you have any doubts, please contact us at Careers@VentraHealth.com to confirm the legitimacy of the offer and the person who contacted you. All legitimate roles are posted on https://ventrahealth.com/careers/.

description:
Note: Only resume shortlisted candidates will be invited for the face-to-face interview on Saturday, 19 September, at 9:00 AM at our Chennai office. 
 Job Description Position 1: Executive/Senior Executive - Vessel Accounts Location: Chennai, India Experience: 2-5 years Qualification: B.Com/M.Com 
 Job Summary The Vessel Accounting Executive will be responsible for vessel financial reporting, fund requests, cash management, balance sheet reconciliations, ageing management, and coordination with vessel owners. The role requires strong accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple activities while ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Vessel Financial Reporting Prepare and share periodic vessel financial reports with vessel owners in accordance with agreed reporting timelines and formats. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of vessel financial information. Coordinate with internal teams to obtain required financial data, invoices, supporting documents, and explanations. Review reports for accuracy and consistency before submission to owners. Respond to owner queries relating to vessel expenses, accounting entries, financial reports, and other accounting matters. Ensure owner-specific reporting requirements are consistently followed. 2. Fund Requests & Cash Management Prepare and raise fund requests for vessel-related expenses, including Budgeted expenses, Non-budgeted expenses, Pre-delivery expenses, Dry-dock expenses Ensure fund requests are accurate, complete, and supported by appropriate documentation and approvals. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders and vessel owners to ensure timely approval and receipt of funds. Monitor outstanding fund requests and proactively follow up on pending items. Ensure fund requirements are communicated to owners within agreed timelines. Maintain appropriate records and supporting documentation for fund requests and cash movements. 3. New Vessel Takeovers & Owner Coordination Liaise with vessel owners during the takeover of new vessels to understand their accounting, reporting, and financial requirements. Coordinate with internal teams during the vessel takeover process to ensure a smooth transition of accounting activities. Understand and document owner-specific accounting requirements, reporting formats, timelines, approval processes, and fund management procedures. Ensure agreed owner requirements are effectively communicated to relevant internal teams and implemented. Support the finance team in establishing accounting processes and controls for newly taken-over vessels. 4. Balance Sheet Schedules & Ageing Management Prepare monthly balance sheet schedules and reconciliations for assigned vessels. Review outstanding and ageing items and identify discrepancies, unreconciled balances, and long-pending transactions. Follow up proactively with relevant departments and stakeholders for resolution of ageing items. Ensure timely clearance and proper accounting treatment of outstanding balances. Maintain accurate supporting schedules and documentation for audit and management review. Highlight significant or long-outstanding items to management and ensure appropriate action is taken. Support month-end and year-end closing activities as required. 5. Customer Service & Owner Satisfaction Ensure customer/owner satisfaction by responding to queries in a timely, professional, and accurate manner. Understand customer requirements and provide clear and appropriate responses within agreed timelines. Coordinate with relevant internal teams to obtain accurate information and resolve customer queries effectively. Proactively follow up on pending issues and keep customers informed of progress until resolution. Build and maintain positive working relationships with vessel owners and other key stakeholders. Escalate critical or unresolved matters to management in a timely manner. Required Qualification & Experience Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Master of Commerce (M.Com) from a recognized university. 2-5 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance. Experience in vessel accounting, shipping finance, or maritime accounting will be an added advantage. Good understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, financial reporting, and general ledger activities. Working knowledge of MS Excel and accounting/ERP systems. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet reporting deadlines. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Key Competencies Fund management and cash flow coordination Ageing analysis and follow-up Stakeholder/owner management Analytical and problem-solving skills Time management and ability to meet deadlines Strong written and verbal communication Proficiency in MS Excel
